bodies.name: Village of Pelham
bodies.label: Village Government
bodies.description: The local government for Pelham Heights and the former North Pelham. An elected Mayor and Board of Trustees set policy and the budget, and run day-to-day services: police, fire, public works (roads, sanitation, storm sewers) and building permits.

bodies.name: Town of Pelham
bodies.label: Town Government
bodies.description: The Town provides services shared by all residents: EMS, tax assessment and collection, and the town courts. The library, recreation programs, and senior services are also Town-run and available to everyone.

meeting_schedule.participation: Public hearing notices posted; residents may comment during hearings

bodies.public_comment_process: Public comment is often called from the floor — residents simply stand or raise their hand when the chair invites public comment.
bodies.layer_controls: Services shared by all residents: EMS, tax assessment and collection, and the town courts — plus the library, recreation programs and senior services.

bodies.name: Pelham Union Free School District
bodies.label: School District
bodies.description: An elected Board of Education governs K–12 education across four elementary schools, one middle school, and Pelham Memorial High School. The school district has its own budget voted on separately by residents each May.

meeting_schedule.participation: Public comment period; annual budget vote each May

bodies.public_comment_process: A floor-based process similar to the Town Board — residents stand or raise their hand when the chair invites public comment.
bodies.layer_controls: K–12 education across four elementary schools, the middle school and Pelham Memorial High School.

bodies.name: Westchester County
bodies.label: County Government
bodies.description: For Pelham residents the County is mostly two things: a share of the property tax bill, and county-wide services — county police and public safety, the courts, the health department and county parks. It also sets the equalization rates used in property assessments. It is not a local board residents deal with day to day; Pelham has one seat in the County Legislature.
bodies.layer_controls: A share of the tax bill, and county-wide services: county police and public safety, the courts, health and parks — plus the equalization rates used in property assessments.
